title: Hedy Lamarr and George Antheil Invention Papers
notes: Finding aid (SOVA) for the Archives Center, National Museum of American History collection NMAH.AC.1590, processed by archivist Alison Oswald, 2023; donated by Denise Loder Deluca, daughter of Hedy Lamarr, 2023. Its Historical note cites Rhodes, Hedy's Folly (Doubleday, 2011). The collection itself (invention notebook, patent correspondence) is the original record; this finding aid is the museum writing about it, so institutional. Snapshot by browser: sova.si.edu answers plain fetches with 403.
